close_reason: Filed as standalone issue JMAP-yecd.1 for future work; architectural trait change beyond scope of this review cycle
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set destroy loop calls destroy_object once per email when onDestroyRemoveEmails=true; for a mailbox with M emails that produces M+2 backend calls. The trait comment acknowledges this gap but there is no filed issue and no batch API. Any backend implementor copying this pattern inherits O(n) round-trips. Maintenance consequence: when a real backend is wired in, destroy of a large mailbox will be catastrophically slow and the author will not know why until profiling.
title: MailBackend trait has no batchDestroy; cascade is O(n) backend calls
